_comment: People who appear in the user's life but never consented to being trained into model weights. Read by jarvis_core/specialists/third_parties.py, which replaces each identifier with its role placeholder in every artifact training consumes (blended_corpus.jsonl, sft_pairs*.jsonl). Tracked deliberately: the canonical corpus build runs on the work laptop, and a machine-local list would silently fail there. Adds no exposure — every identifier here is already tracked inside personal_life.md. To cover a new person, add an entry; check_pipeline's 'no third-party identity in training' invariant then enforces it. It CANNOT catch a person who is not listed.
